statements.statement: The policy pays up to $1,200 for replacing the windscreen.
statements.quote: We cover repair or replacement of the windscreen, side windows, rear window and sunroof of the vehicle, including recalibration of cameras and sensors mounted on the windscreen, up to a limit of $1,200 per claim.

statements.statement: The policy has a glass excess of $75.
statements.quote: You pay the following excess on each claim: collision claims $400; glass claims $75; theft claims $600. We deduct the excess from the amount we pay.
